home.title: Practice git until it stops being scary
home.pitch: Short, game-like scenarios in a real-feeling terminal. Every command you type redraws a live commit graph, so you see what branch, merge and rebase actually do.
home.teammates: And you are not alone in the repo: simulated teammates push to origin while you work. Learn to sync, rebase and resolve conflicts the way it happens on a team.
home.local: Runs in your browser. Progress stays on this device.
